title: Ab to Aayiye baba
body:
1. Hai Yateem Ka Nauha , Ab To Aayiye Baba.
Dil Sukoon Paayega, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Maar Kar Layeeno'N Ne Cheen Li Meri Chadar.
Hogayi Mai Beparda, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Chin Gaye Mere Gauhar, Zulm Yeh Hua Mujhpar.
Jal Gaya Mera Kurta, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aapko Bulati Hu'N, Mai Tamache Khati Hun.
Haal Hai Yahi Mera, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Be Kajawa Naqe Par Baandha Mujhko Zalim Ne.
Zaqmi Hai Mera Seena, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ris Raha Hai Kaano'N Se Qoon Mere Shaano'N Par.
Ab Bhi Zaqm Hai Taaza, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Is Andhere Zinda'N Mein Kuch Nazar Nahi Aata.
Ghut Raha Hai Dum Mera, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Pyaas Ke Sabab Baba Mujhko Apni Aankho'N Se.
Kuch Nazar Nahi Aata, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Chaar Saal Mein Baba Mai Zayeef Lagti Hun. Aur Kya Kahu'N Baba, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Mar Gayi Kumail Aaqir Tang Qaid Mein Bachi.
Koun Ab Pukarega, Ab To Aayiye Baba.
Az: Meer Kumail Ali(Anjuman E Asghari).
